headings: (500 ML) CEDAR WOOD HAND AND BODY SOAP

jsonld_raw.name: (500 ML) CEDAR WOOD HAND AND BODY SOAP
jsonld_raw.description:
Perfumed liquid hand and body soap. Comes in a container with a dispenser.

Cedar Wood. The scents of a traditional apothecary—floral, woody, and sweet—merge to create a modern and contemporary fragrance collection. Citrusy and floral, discover its woody base subtly sweetened by a touch of sugar cane.

Scent notes:
Top notes: citrus, tangerine, grapefruit.
Heart notes: floral, freesia, jasmine.
Base notes: aromatic, cedar wood, sugar cane.
